settingsHelp: AI checks the text before processing. You choose the actions and recipients.
noProvider: No AI API configured: requests are held for review.
providerHelp: Settings saved here take priority over the API server’s .env. Leave the URL or model blank to use its server value.
penaltyPoints: Points deducted for discarded abuse (signed-in accounts; 0 = none)
reclassify: Reclassify if another subject is identified
routesHelp: All accepted requests stay in Messages → Contact. To send a copy, configure SMTP and enable the contact alert in the mail centre. Sending limits still apply.
queueHelp: This inbox is shared on the server, not in the visitor’s browser. Filter by “Needs review” and open a record to read it. Select “New” for internal follow-up. Editing a record sends no email.
confirmPurge: Permanently delete this request and its follow-up note from the CMS?
balance: {score} points · {total} active note(s). The latest 20 are shown.
confirmRetract: Remove this note and restore its points?
keyHelp: Leave the key blank to keep the saved key for the same URL, or use the .env key at its original URL. Enter a separate key for a different URL.
confirmEnv: Remove this page’s AI settings, including its key, and use the server configuration?
testHelp: The test uses the current fields and sample text. It does not save changes or send a visitor’s message.
envRestored: Page settings cleared. The API server’s .env is in use again.
connectionError: Unable to manage the AI connection.
testResult_ok: Connected: the model returned a valid screening result.
testResult_incomplete: Incomplete connection. Check the URL, model and key for this URL.
testResult_auth: Authentication refused. Check the key and its access to the model.
testResult_unavailable: Provider unavailable or request refused. Check the URL and model, then try again.
testResult_invalidResponse: Incompatible response: this model must return the expected JSON verdict.
updateApi: Update the CMS API as well to display the AI connection fields.
promptSettingsHelp: Customize instructions sent to the model. The result must follow the JSON output contract so automatic triage and manual verification work.
userPromptTemplateHelp: Available variables: {{subject}}, {{message}}, {{locale}}, {{json}}. {{json}} inserts the JSON object {subject,message,locale}.
outputContractHelp: The model response must be valid JSON matching this schema. Automatic/on-demand processing relies on these fields.
